NKJV.1: Now the leaders of the people dwelt at Jerusalem; the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine-tenths were to dwell in other cities.
NKJV.2: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
NKJV.3: These are the heads of the province who dwelt in Jerusalem. (But in the cities of Judah everyone dwelt in his own possession in their cities—Israelites, priests, Levites, Nethinim, and descendants of Solomon’s servants.)
NKJV.4: Also in Jerusalem dwelt some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin. The children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
NKJV.5: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
NKJV.6: All the sons of Perez who dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred and sixty-eight valiant men.
NKJV.7: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;
NKJV.8: and after him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.
NKJV.9: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
NKJV.10: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, and Jachin;
NKJV.11: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the leader of the house of God.
NKJV.12: Their brethren who did the work of the house were eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
NKJV.13: and his brethren, heads of the fathers’ houses, were two hundred and forty-two; and Amashai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
NKJV.14: and their brethren, mighty men of valor, were one hundred and twenty-eight. Their overseer was Zabdiel the son of one of the great men.
NKJV.15: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
NKJV.16: Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the heads of the Levites, had the oversight of the business outside of the house of God;
NKJV.17: Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the leader who began the thanksgiving with prayer; Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
NKJV.18: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred and eighty-four.
NKJV.19: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren who kept the gates, were one hundred and seventy-two.
NKJV.20: And the rest of Israel, of the priests and Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
NKJV.21: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel. And Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
NKJV.22: Also the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha, of the sons of Asaph, the singers in charge of the service of the house of God.
NKJV.23: For it was the king’s command concerning them that a certain portion should be for the singers, a quota day by day.
NKJV.24: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was the king’s deputy in all matters concerning the people.
NKJV.25: And as for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt in Kirjath Arba and its villages, Dibon and its villages, Jekabzeel and its villages;
NKJV.27: Hazar Shual, and Beersheba and its villages;
NKJV.28: in Ziklag and Meconah and its villages;
NKJV.30: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages; in Lachish and its fields; in Azekah and its villages. They dwelt from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
NKJV.31: Also the children of Benjamin from Geba dwelt in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel, and their villages;
NKJV.35: in Lod, Ono, and the Valley of Craftsmen.
NKJV.36: Some of the Judean divisions of Levites were in Benjamin.

NLT.1: The leaders of the people were living in Jerusalem, the holy city. A tenth of the people from the other towns of Judah and Benjamin were chosen by sacred lots to live there, too, while the rest stayed where they were.
NLT.2: And the people commended everyone who volunteered to resettle in Jerusalem.
NLT.3: Here is a list of the names of the provincial officials who came to live in Jerusalem. (Most of the people, priests, Levites, Temple servants, and descendants of Solomon’s servants continued to live in their own homes in the various towns of Judah,
NLT.4: but some of the people from Judah and Benjamin resettled in Jerusalem.) From the tribe of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, of the family of Perez.
NLT.5: Also Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, of the family of Shelah.
NLT.6: There were 468 descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem — all outstanding men.
NLT.7: From the tribe of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah.
NLT.8: After him were Gabbai and Sallai and a total of 928 relatives.
NLT.9: Their chief officer was Joel son of Zicri, who was assisted by Judah son of Hassenuah, second-in-command over the city.
NLT.10: From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jakin;
NLT.11: and Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the supervisor of the Temple of God.
NLT.12: Also 822 of their associates, who worked at the Temple. Also Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah,
NLT.13: along with 242 of his associates, who were heads of their families. Also Amashsai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
NLT.14: and 128 of his outstanding associates. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
NLT.15: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni.
NLT.16: Also Shabbethai and Jozabad, who were in charge of the work outside the Temple of God.
NLT.17: Also Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zabdi, a descendant of Asaph, who led in thanksgiving and prayer. Also Bakbukiah, who was Mattaniah’s assistant, and Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
NLT.18: In all, there were 284 Levites in the holy city.
NLT.19: From the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and 172 of their associates, who guarded the gates.
NLT.20: The other priests, Levites, and the rest of the Israelites lived wherever their family inheritance was located in any of the towns of Judah.
NLT.21: The Temple servants, however, whose leaders were Ziha and Gishpa, all lived on the hill of Ophel.
NLT.22: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, a descendant of Asaph, whose family served as singers at God’s Temple.
NLT.23: Their daily responsibilities were carried out according to the terms of a royal command.
NLT.24: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, a descendant of Zerah son of Judah, was the royal adviser in all matters of public administration.
NLT.25: As for the surrounding villages with their open fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba with its settlements, Dibon with its settlements, and Jekabzeel with its villages.
NLT.26: They also lived in Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-pelet,
NLT.28: Ziklag, and Meconah with its settlements.
NLT.29: They also lived in En-rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
NLT.30: Zanoah, and Adullam with their surrounding villages. They also lived in Lachish with its nearby fields and Azekah with its surrounding villages. So the people of Judah were living all the way from Beersheba in the south to the valley of Hinnom.
NLT.31: Some of the people of Benjamin lived at Geba, Micmash, Aija, and Bethel with its settlements.
NLT.32: They also lived in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
NLT.35: Lod, Ono, and the Valley of Craftsmen.
NLT.36: Some of the Levites who lived in Judah were sent to live with the tribe of Benjamin.

WEB.1: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
WEB.2: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
WEB.3: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
WEB.4: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
WEB.5: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
WEB.6: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
WEB.7: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
WEB.8: After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
WEB.9: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
WEB.10: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
WEB.11: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
WEB.12: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
WEB.13: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
WEB.14: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
WEB.15: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
WEB.16: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
WEB.17: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
WEB.18: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
WEB.19: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
WEB.20: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
WEB.21: But the temple servants lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
WEB.22: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
WEB.23: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
WEB.24: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
WEB.25: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
WEB.26: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,
WEB.27: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,
WEB.28: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,
WEB.29: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
WEB.30: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
WEB.31: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
WEB.35: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
WEB.36: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

NRSVCE.8: And his brothers Gabbai, Sallai: nine hundred twenty-eight.
NRSVCE.9: Joel son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in charge of the city.
NRSVCE.10: Of the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jachin,
NRSVCE.11: Seraiah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, officer of the house of God,
NRSVCE.12: and their associates who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pelaliah son of Amzi son of Zechariah son of Pashhur son of Malchijah,
NRSVCE.13: and his associates, heads of ancestral houses, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai son of Azarel son of Ahzai son of Meshillemoth son of Immer,
NRSVCE.14: and their associates, valiant warriors, one hundred twenty-eight; their overseer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
NRSVCE.15: And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah son of Bunni;
NRSVCE.16: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the leaders of the Levites, who were over the outside work of the house of God;
NRSVCE.17: and Mattaniah son of Mica son of Zabdi son of Asaph, who was the leader to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua son of Galal son of Jeduthun.
NRSVCE.18: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
NRSVCE.19: The gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
NRSVCE.20: And the rest of Israel, and of the priests and the Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, all of them in their inheritance.
NRSVCE.21: But the temple servants lived on Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
NRSVCE.22: The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani son of Hashabiah son of Mattaniah son of Mica, of the descendants of Asaph, the singers, in charge of the work of the house of God.
NRSVCE.23: For there was a command from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as was required every day.
NRSVCE.24: And Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
NRSVCE.25: And as for the villages, with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its villages, and in Dibon and its villages, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
NRSVCE.26: and in Jeshua and in Moladah and Beth-pelet,
NRSVCE.27: in Hazar-shual, in Beer-sheba and its villages,
NRSVCE.28: in Ziklag, in Meconah and its villages,
NRSVCE.29: in En-rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
NRSVCE.30: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its villages. So they camped from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.
NRSVCE.31: The people of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash, Aija, Bethel and its villages,
NRSVCE.35: Lod, and Ono, the valley of artisans.
NRSVCE.36: And certain divisions of the Levites in Judah were joined to Benjamin.

NET.1: So the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, while the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten to settle in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the other nine remained in other cities.
NET.2: The people gave their blessing on all the men who volunteered to settle in Jerusalem.
NET.3: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem. (While other Israelites, the priests, the Levites, the temple attendants, and the sons of the servants of Solomon settled in the cities of Judah, each on his own property in their cities,
NET.4: some of the descendants of Judah and some of the descendants of Benjamin settled in Jerusalem.) Of the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, from the descendants of Perez;
NET.5: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Col-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, from the descendants of Shelah.
NET.6: The sum total of the descendants of Perez who were settling in Jerusalem was 468 exceptional men.
NET.7: These are the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,
NET.8: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai — 928 in all.
NET.9: Joel son of Zicri was the officer in charge of them, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second-in-command over the city.
NET.10: From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jakin,
NET.11: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, supervisor in the temple of God,
NET.12: and their colleagues who were carrying out work for the temple — 822; and Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,
NET.13: and his colleagues who were heads of families — 242; and Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
NET.14: and his colleagues who were exceptional men — 128. The officer over them was Zabdiel the son of Haggedolim.
NET.15: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
NET.16: Shabbethai and Jozabad, leaders of the Levites, were in charge of the external work for the temple of God;
NET.17: Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the praise leader who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his colleagues; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
NET.18: The sum total of the Levites in the holy city was 284.
NET.19: And the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their colleagues who were guarding the gates — 172.
NET.20: And the rest of the Israelites, with the priests and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, each on his own property.
NET.21: The temple attendants were living on Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were over them.
NET.22: The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica. He was one of Asaph’s descendants who were the singers responsible for the service of the temple of God.
NET.23: For they were under royal orders which determined their activity day by day.
NET.24: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was an adviser to the king in every matter pertaining to the people.
NET.25: As for the settlements with their fields, some of the people of Judah settled in Kiriath Arba and its neighboring villages, in Dibon and its villages, in Jekabzeel and its settlements,
NET.26: in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet,
NET.27: in Hazar Shual, in Beer Sheba and its villages,
NET.28: in Ziklag, in Meconah and its villages,
NET.29: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
NET.30: Zanoah, Adullam and their settlements, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its villages. So they were encamped from Beer Sheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
NET.31: Some of the descendants of Benjamin settled in Geba, Micmash, Aija, Bethel and its villages,
NET.35: in Lod, Ono, and the Valley of the Craftsmen.
NET.36: Some of the Judean divisions of the Levites settled in Benjamin.
